citation.title: Managing Fractured Ceramic Restorations: Current Evidence and Best Practices—A Scoping Review
citation.authors: Gabriela Almeida, Joana A. Marques, Markus B. Blatz, Rui I. Falacho
citation.journal: Journal of Esthetic and Restorative Dentistry

s_design.anchor: Systematic scoping review (PRISMA-ScR, three-database search) of predominantly in-vitro repair studies (MATERIAL SR/MA of in-vitro studies row, 100)
s_design.evidence_quote: this scoping review aims to assess the effect

domains.note: Absence: read Methodology 2 (reporting statement), 2.1 Eligibility Criteria, 2.2 Information Sources and Search Strategy, 2.3 Selection of Sources of Evidence, 2.4 Data Extraction, plus Funding/Disclosure/Data Availability and Supporting Information blocks; no protocol, registration, PROSPERO, OSF or a priori protocol is mentioned anywhere. The paper cites PRISMA-ScR reporting guidance only.

domains.evidence_quote: An electronic search was conducted in three databases (PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Embase)
domains.note: Three bibliographic databases (MEDLINE via PubMed, Cochrane Library, Embase), above the 2-database threshold; reference lists also screened.

domains.evidence_quote: 2423 remaining after duplicate removal. Title and abstract screening resulted in the exclusion of 2136 and 136 studies, respectively.
domains.note: No list of excluded full-text studies with reasons (37 full-text exclusions reported only as a count), but (a) a screening account with counts and PRISMA flowchart (Figure 1) and (b) explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria (2.1) are both reported (3b-iii line 2).

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: Absence: read Methodology 2.1-2.4 (eligibility, search, selection, data extraction), Results 3, Discussion 4-4.5 and Limitations 5; data extraction lists study type, sample size, materials, groups, outcome, aging and main findings only; no quality, risk-of-bias, appraisal or critical-appraisal tool or step is described for the included studies anywhere in the text.

Absence: read Methodology 2.1-2.4, Results 3 and Discussion 4; no meta-analysis, pooling, statistical synthesis, heterogeneity test or effect model is described; synthesis is narrative/tabular (Table 2) only.
Absence: read Methodology 2.1-2.4, Results 3, Discussion 4 and Limitations 5; no publication bias, small-study effect, funnel plot or related assessment is mentioned.

sources.fact_fa: این مقاله امتیاز ۳۰ و باند D (شواهد ضعیف) را در نوع پرسش MATERIAL می‌گیرد.
sources.interpretation_fa: این scoping review با جست‌وجوی سه پایگاه داده ۱۲۶ مطالعه‌ی عمدتاً in vitro را نقشه‌برداری کرده، اما protocol ثبت‌شده و ارزیابی risk of bias مطالعات ندارد. ارزشش مرور منظم پروتکل‌های تعمیر است: hydrofluoric acid و silane برای glass ceramic، و air abrasion با primer حاوی MDP برای metal oxide ceramic. این نتایج بر bond strength آزمایشگاهی تکیه دارند، نه پیامد بالینی.

claims.source_quote:
Based on this scoping review, the following conclusions can
be drawn:
• Methodological heterogeneity among studies and the absence of clinical trials precludes the establishment of definitive clinical conclusions;
• In ceramic repair procedures, glass ceramics should be
treated with a combination of hydrofluoric acid etching and
silanization, while metal oxide ceramics demonstrate superior outcomes when air abrasion and an MDP-­containing
primer are employed;
• Standardized methodologies should be established to enable the design of more consistent and comparable laboratory and clinical studies.
claims.note: inference judged on conclusion; heterogeneity and absence of clinical trials preclude definitive clinical conclusions

fidelity.source_conclusion: Based on this scoping review, the following conclusions can be drawn: • Methodological heterogeneity among studies and the absence of clinical trials precludes the establishment of definitive clinical conclusions; • In ceramic repair procedures, glass ceramics should be treated with a combination of hydrofluoric acid etching and silanization, while metal oxide ceramics demonstrate superior outcomes when air abrasion and an MDP-­containing primer are employed; • Standardized methodologies should be established to enable the design of more consistent and comparable laboratory and clinical studies.

fidelity.interpretation_fa: هر ادعای قابل‌بررسی با منبع مطابق است.
